select
    *,
    try_cast(SK_ID_BUREAU as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_bureau,
    try_cast(MONTHS_BALANCE as integer) as normalized_months_balance,

    case
        when STATUS in ('0', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5')
        then try_cast(STATUS as integer)
        else null
    end as STATUS_DPD,

    case when STATUS = 'C' then 1 else 0 end as IS_CLOSED,
    case when STATUS = 'X' then 1 else 0 end as IS_UNKNOWN

from "credit_lakehouse"."bronze"."bureau_balance"

select
    *,
    try_cast(SK_ID_CURR as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_curr,
    try_cast(AMT_CREDIT as double) as normalized_amt_credit,
    try_cast(AMT_INCOME_TOTAL as double) as normalized_amt_income_total,
    try_cast(AMT_ANNUITY as double) as normalized_amt_annuity,
    case when try_cast(AMT_CREDIT as double) is null or try_cast(AMT_CREDIT as double) <= 0 then 1 else 0 end as flag_amt_credit_nonpositive_or_invalid,
    case when try_cast(AMT_INCOME_TOTAL as double) is null or try_cast(AMT_INCOME_TOTAL as double) <= 0 then 1 else 0 end as flag_amt_income_nonpositive_or_invalid,
    try_cast(DAYS_BIRTH as integer) as source_days_birth_integer,
    case when try_cast(DAYS_BIRTH as integer) is not null
         then cast(abs(try_cast(DAYS_BIRTH as integer)) / 365.25 as integer) end as derived_age_years,
    try_cast(DAYS_EMPLOYED as integer) as source_days_employed_integer,
    case when try_cast(DAYS_EMPLOYED as integer) = 365243 then null
         else try_cast(DAYS_EMPLOYED as integer) end as cleaned_days_employed,
    case when try_cast(DAYS_EMPLOYED as integer) = 365243 then 1 else 0 end as flag_days_employed_anomaly
from "credit_lakehouse"."bronze"."application_test"

select
    *,
    try_cast(SK_ID_CURR as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_curr,
    try_cast(SK_ID_BUREAU as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_bureau,
    try_cast(AMT_ANNUITY as double) as normalized_amt_annuity,
    case when AMT_ANNUITY is null or trim(AMT_ANNUITY) = '' then 1 else 0 end as flag_amt_annuity_missing
from "credit_lakehouse"."bronze"."bureau"

select
    *,
    try_cast(SK_ID_CURR as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_curr,
    try_cast(TARGET as integer) as normalized_target,
    try_cast(AMT_CREDIT as double) as normalized_amt_credit,
    try_cast(AMT_INCOME_TOTAL as double) as normalized_amt_income_total,
    try_cast(AMT_ANNUITY as double) as normalized_amt_annuity,
    case when try_cast(AMT_CREDIT as double) is null or try_cast(AMT_CREDIT as double) <= 0 then 1 else 0 end as flag_amt_credit_nonpositive_or_invalid,
    case when try_cast(AMT_INCOME_TOTAL as double) is null or try_cast(AMT_INCOME_TOTAL as double) <= 0 then 1 else 0 end as flag_amt_income_nonpositive_or_invalid,
    try_cast(DAYS_BIRTH as integer) as source_days_birth_integer,
    case when try_cast(DAYS_BIRTH as integer) is not null
         then cast(abs(try_cast(DAYS_BIRTH as integer)) / 365.25 as integer) end as derived_age_years,
    try_cast(DAYS_EMPLOYED as integer) as source_days_employed_integer,
    case when try_cast(DAYS_EMPLOYED as integer) = 365243 then null
         else try_cast(DAYS_EMPLOYED as integer) end as cleaned_days_employed,
    case when try_cast(DAYS_EMPLOYED as integer) = 365243 then 1 else 0 end as flag_days_employed_anomaly
from "credit_lakehouse"."bronze"."application_train"

select
    *,
    try_cast(SK_ID_CURR as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_curr,
    try_cast(SK_ID_PREV as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_prev,
    try_cast(MONTHS_BALANCE as integer) as normalized_months_balance,
    try_cast(AMT_BALANCE as double) as normalized_amt_balance,
    try_cast(AMT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ACTUAL as double) as normalized_amt_credit_limit_actual,
    case when try_cast(AMT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ACTUAL as double) > 0
         then try_cast(AMT_BALANCE as double) / try_cast(AMT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ACTUAL as double) end as derived_credit_utilization
from "credit_lakehouse"."bronze"."credit_card_balance"

select
    *,
    try_cast(SK_ID_CURR as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_curr,
    try_cast(SK_ID_PREV as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_prev,
    try_cast(NUM_INSTALMENT_VERSION as integer) as normalized_instalment_version,
    try_cast(NUM_INSTALMENT_NUMBER as integer) as normalized_instalment_number,
    try_cast(DAYS_INSTALMENT as double) as normalized_days_instalment,
    try_cast(DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT as double) as normalized_days_entry_payment,
    try_cast(AMT_INSTALMENT as double) as normalized_amt_instalment,
    try_cast(AMT_PAYMENT as double) as normalized_amt_payment,
    case when DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT is null or trim(DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT) = '' then 1 else 0 end as flag_unpaid_installment,
    case when DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT is null or trim(DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT) = '' then null
         else greatest(0, try_cast(DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT as double) - try_cast(DAYS_INSTALMENT as double)) end as derived_dpd_installment
from "credit_lakehouse"."bronze"."installments_payments"

select
    *,
    try_cast(SK_ID_CURR as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_curr,
    try_cast(SK_ID_PREV as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_prev,
    try_cast(MONTHS_BALANCE as integer) as normalized_months_balance,
    try_cast(SK_DPD as integer) as normalized_sk_dpd,
    try_cast(SK_DPD_DEF as integer) as normalized_sk_dpd_def
from "credit_lakehouse"."bronze"."pos_cash_balance"

select
    * exclude (RATE_INTEREST_PRIMARY),
    try_cast(SK_ID_CURR as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_curr,
    try_cast(SK_ID_PREV as bigint) as normalized_sk_id_prev,
    try_cast(AMT_CREDIT as double) as normalized_amt_credit,
    try_cast(AMT_ANNUITY as double) as normalized_amt_annuity
from "credit_lakehouse"."bronze"."previous_application"

select STATUS
from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_bureau_balance"
where STATUS is null

select normalized_sk_id_curr
from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_application_test"
where normalized_sk_id_curr is null

select
    normalized_sk_id_curr as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_application_test"
where normalized_sk_id_curr is not null
group by normalized_sk_id_curr
having count(*) > 1

with all_values as (

    select
        STATUS as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_bureau_balance"
    group by STATUS

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'C','0','1','2','3','4','5','X'
)

select normalized_sk_id_bureau
from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_bureau"
where normalized_sk_id_bureau is null

with all_values as (

    select
        normalized_target as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_application_train"
    group by normalized_target

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    '0','1'
)

select normalized_sk_id_curr
from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_application_train"
where normalized_sk_id_curr is null

select
    normalized_sk_id_curr as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_application_train"
where normalized_sk_id_curr is not null
group by normalized_sk_id_curr
having count(*) > 1

select
    normalized_sk_id_curr as sk_id_curr,
    normalized_target as target,
    normalized_amt_credit as amt_credit,
    normalized_amt_income_total as amt_income_total,
    normalized_amt_annuity as amt_annuity,
    derived_age_years as age_years,
    cleaned_days_employed,
    flag_days_employed_anomaly,
    CODE_GENDER as code_gender,
    NAME_CONTRACT_TYPE as name_contract_type,
    cast(SK_ID_CURR as varchar) as source_sk_id_curr
from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_application_train"

select
    normalized_sk_id_bureau as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_bureau"
where normalized_sk_id_bureau is not null
group by normalized_sk_id_bureau
having count(*) > 1

with all_values as (

    select
        STATUS_DPD as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_bureau_balance"
    group by STATUS_DPD

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    '0','1','2','3','4','5'
)
select * from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."int_application_train_prep"

select
    *,
    case when amt_income_total > 0 then amt_credit / amt_income_total end as credit_to_income,
    case when amt_income_total > 0 then amt_annuity / amt_income_total end as annuity_to_income
from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."int_application_train_prep"

select *
from "credit_lakehouse"."silver"."stg_bureau_balance"
where
    (
        STATUS = 'C'
        and (
            STATUS_DPD is not null
            or IS_CLOSED is distinct from 1
            or IS_UNKNOWN is distinct from 0
        )
    )
    or (
        STATUS = 'X'
        and (
            STATUS_DPD is not null
            or IS_CLOSED is distinct from 0
            or IS_UNKNOWN is distinct from 1
        )
    )
    or (
        STATUS in ('0', '1', '2', '3', '4', '5')
        and (
            STATUS_DPD is distinct from try_cast(STATUS as integer)
            or IS_CLOSED is distinct from 0
            or IS_UNKNOWN is distinct from 0
        )
    )
